solve_ivp_dt: solve an initial value problem for a system of ODEs using explicit methods like rk4 or euler
solve_hamiltonian_ivp_dt: solve a Hamiltonian system initial value problem using symplectic integrators like leap_frog or stormer_verlet
solve_ivp_t_eval: solve an ODE initial value problem and evaluate the solution at specified time points within a time span
solve_hamiltonian_ivp_t_eval: solve a Hamiltonian system and evaluate the phase space solution at specified time points within a time span
get_integrator: get a named integrator instance like rk4, leap_frog, or ruth4 by string name or pass a custom callable
